<!-- pr-reviewer: bed362c6a95e8ec415f5772e05a451c353a1d2ed -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

What looks good
- `posting::posted_rpm` (posting.rs:187-190) is the single answer; the post (posting.rs:773) and the machine spindle clause (machine/mod.rs:178-193) both read it. Posted output is unchanged: the post's old expression is moved verbatim into the helper.
- Cutters are still judged by their own rpm against both the minimum and maximum; only `ToolKind::Probe` yields 0 and skips the clause. `a_cutter_below_the_minimum_is_still_refused_beside_a_probe` pins that the refusal is not silenced and names only the cutter.
- No unwrap/panic in src; new tests use expect (tests only). Provenance/decision file present, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #565`, no CHANGELOG.md edit, no new deps/scripts.

Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main 66791aa6, clean merge)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| conformance | 6 passed |
| machine | 32 passed |
| machine_library | 11 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| probe_op | 11 passed |
| probe_spindle_range | 3 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- machine/mod.rs is 420 lines (was ~418); posting.rs is 1100 lines. Both already over the ~400 guideline, growth is negligible.
- The probing program on a real 770MX is left to #521's hands-on test, as the body says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
